contextual.keys: L repeatedly: 2x, 3x, 5x, 8x; K+L / K+J: slow forward/backward (8 fps NTSC, 6 fps PAL and 24p); hold K and tap J or L: step one frame; Alt+J / Alt+L: one speed step
F4: Mark IN, then Mark OUT and Log; F1/F2: subclip IN/OUT while capturing; Esc: stop capture; Tab: move between fields
Numeric keypad 1-9 select the camera angle by its position in the split display
F3/F5-F12 add coloured locators while capturing (Red, Red, Green, Blue, Cyan, Magenta, Yellow, Black, White)
Ctrl+N: New Bin (in 2025 a Bin Container context-menu command, EG p.295)
Ctrl+[ / Ctrl+]: less/more detail; Ctrl+/: show entire sequence; Ctrl+M: zoom to selection; Ctrl+J: previous zoom; Shift+Ctrl+A: deselect all tracks
Ctrl+=: open the settings of the active window
